text: You just keep getting stuck between ideas, plans, and starting over.
If your notes are full, your tabs are open, and your next step still feels unclear,
The Life You Keep Planning, by Belinda Bright N., is a practical guide to overthinking less, and finally following through.
Inside, you'll find the SELECT method, a one-project card, and a thirty-day follow-through programme.
If you're ready to stop planning and start moving, the ebook is ready to pre-order now on Amazon U.K.
Kindle, three ninety-nine. Paperback, nine ninety-nine. Out January the twenty-third.
